justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both include a human/anthropomorphic form and circular motifs, though in A the circles include a chariot wheel while in B they function as parts of a frontal schematic body or face. The biggest difference is that A is a narrative profile scene with chariot, horses, weapons, and an animal encounter, whereas B is a single frontal, highly geometric anthropomorphic figure with no comparable animals, vehicle, or action.
